correctness.rationale: The one-sided Rudin–Shapiro sign recursion r(2n)=r(n), r(2n+1)=(-1)^n r(n), and the four equally spaced factors give exact dyadic invariance C(2h)=C(h). The actual package verify.py defines a 30-state carry/sign transducer with three addition carries and four previous bits. I independently reimplemented its state graph: exactly 30 reachable states, exact zero-digit three-step dual stationary functional T0* f3=2f3, bounded terminal dual |f3|<=8, and exact C(1)=-1/2. All 16 odd five-bit prefixes have norm partition >16 iff prefixes 1,31, =16 iff 15,17; those boundary prefixes contract on either next spacing bit. The only two exceptional eventual constant-bit branches obey independently recomputed explicit affine vector recurrences and norm identities, including stable signs for every integer parameter t>=7; their departure contracts to strictly below 1/2 even under mandatory zero padding. Therefore no finite cutoff is substituted for the all-h bound, and the equality set is exactly powers of two. Direct independent exact terminal correlations for 150 additional odd gaps (3..299) corroborate this unrestricted proof. C is defined only for four arithmetic-progression sites and Cesàro average on the balanced Rudin–Shapiro subshift.
